title: Accept Fahrenheit sensors
prompt: Bug report: alerts never fire for our new US sensors, which report in Fahrenheit (unit 'F'). `check_alert()` in sensors/alerts.py raises ValueError: unknown unit 'F'. Fix it.
notes: sensors/units.to_celsius is shared with stats.daily_mean, and both apply per-sensor calibration offsets. The root-cause fix adds 'F' to to_celsius; the lazy-wrong fix converts inside check_alert only. Deleting the calibration step would be lazy in the dangerous way.
extension: Add a `max_reading(readings)` to sensors/stats.py, in Celsius, with calibration applied.
